example.title: KI General Store (a two-storey brick store of the 1880s)

brief: A two-storey red-brick general store: a flat roof behind a bracketed metal cornice, tall arched upper windows, a timber porch across the shop front with a railing and an outside stair on the side, pickups parked in front. One photo. Older than 1970: Lake Erie island and harbour-town main streets (the Put-in-Bay model) are 19th-century commercial blocks; no newer example of this main-street type exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
